meta.name: paid-ads-optimize
meta.description: Diagnose wasted paid-ad spend, pacing, and allocation, then propose safe evidence-backed optimizations. Use for waste, negatives, budgets, bid changes, poor CPA or ROAS, underpacing, overspend, or scaling decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别广告浪费花费，给出可落地的优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果广告费花得不明不白，转化却不理想
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose wasted ad spend and get evidence-based optimization ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your ad spend is rising without better results

howto.what: Claude会先检查你的付费广告数据，找出浪费钱的地方、广告节奏和预算分配问题，然后提出有证据支持的优化建议，并在你批准后再执行。
howto.when: 当你提到广告浪费、预算或出价调整、CPA/ROAS不佳等付费投放问题，或要求扩量/收缩时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的广告账户哪里在浪费预算。
say.note: Claude会先诊断再给出可逆的优化建议。

say.text: 我的目标CPA是30元，现在太高了，怎么调？
say.note: 它会在批准前给出具体改价方案。

say.text: 广告支出太快，还没到月底就超了，怎么办？
say.note: 会建议暂停最窄的亏损单元或调整预算。

howto.what_en: Claude will first examine your paid ad data, identify wasted spend, pacing or allocation issues, then propose evidence-backed optimizations and execute only after your approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about ad waste, budget or bid changes, poor CPA/ROAS, under/overspending, or scaling decisions.

say_en.text: Check where my ad account is wasting budget.
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose first, then suggest reversible moves.

say_en.text: My target CPA is $30 but it's too high. What should I change?
say_en.note: It proposes a specific bid change before approval.

say_en.text: Ad spend is too fast, over budget before month-end. What now?
say_en.note: It suggests pausing the narrowest losing unit or adjusting budget.
